BiblicalUsage: Atroth-beth-Joab was a town of the sons of Salma, named once in the genealogy of Judah among the families of Bethlehem. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the town's place in the record ties it to Bethlehem's families, and the smallest places still belong to the story.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
